label: medical_imaging
name: Medical Imaging Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR medical image into one or more detailed categories based on the imaging technique, visible anatomy, image characteristics, and diagnostic context.

labels.x_ray: A medical image primarily showing an X-ray or radiograph of bones, chest, joints, or another body part.
labels.ct_scan: A medical image primarily showing cross-sectional computed tomography images of the head, chest, abdomen, spine, or another body region.
labels.mri: A medical image primarily showing magnetic resonance imaging of the brain, spine, joints, organs, or soft tissue.
labels.ultrasound: A medical image primarily showing an ultrasound or sonogram of internal organs, pregnancy, blood vessels, or soft tissue.
labels.mammogram: A medical image primarily showing breast tissue captured using mammography.
labels.dental_imaging: A medical image primarily showing teeth, jaws, gums, or dental structures using an X-ray or dental scan.
labels.pathology: A medical image primarily showing tissue samples, biopsy material, cells, or histology slides used for diagnosis.
labels.endoscopy: A medical image captured from inside the body using an endoscope, such as the stomach, intestine, throat, or airway.
labels.retinal_imaging: A medical image primarily showing the retina, optic disc, blood vessels, or internal structures of the eye.
labels.nuclear_medicine: A medical image primarily showing a PET scan, SPECT scan, or another radioactive tracer-based diagnostic scan.
